name: admin-fullstack-starter
description: Vue 3 + NestJS 后台管理系统全栈基础模板（类 Monorepo：frontend / backend 独立依赖，根目录统一编排）

scripts.install:all: pnpm run install:frontend && pnpm run install:backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "pnpm run dev:frontend" "pnpm run dev:backend"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:backend
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:frontend && pnpm run lint:backend
